verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation and registered-agent service, so a public API for entity records and agent appointments is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents such an API. The only API mention is an "Advanced API integrations" line item on the pricing page, listed near the sales-tax and Stripe features, which does not describe a public developer API. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. Entity status and registered-agent changes are described only through the in-app dashboard.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read or manage entity records and registered-agent appointments programmatically through a documented public API
